plain_definition: Financial Aid checks that your FAFSA information is correct. You send documents to prove it.
Rules about grades and finished classes you must meet to keep getting aid.
A request to keep your aid even though you did not meet SAP rules, usually because of a hard situation.
When aid money is paid to your student account.
Federal money for school that you do not pay back.
A loan you pay back, but the government pays the interest while you are in school.
A short online lesson you must finish before your first student loan.
The agreement you sign promising to repay a federal student loan.
The law that covers federal student aid. Title IV aid means federal grants and loans.
When the college drops you from classes, for example for not paying.
